[[File:QuebeLuxfause.jpg|thumb|The Quebe-Luxfause Systems headquarter in Mos Eisley.]]
'''Quebe-Luxfause Systems''' was a company that manufactured [[queblux]]-powered technology at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They had a [[Quebe-Luxfause Systems headquarters|headquarters]] in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] spaceport of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> They manufactured the [[Queblux Power Train]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|Vol III, ''p.'' 67}}</ref>

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Quebe-Luxfase was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
